verdict.rationale: Linear shows real handoff mechanisms: agents can be delegated issues (not just assigned, preserving human ownership), work across GitHub/Copilot/Claude Code/Codex agents, use Loops for recurring handoffs, MCP server for external agent connections, webhooks/API for programmatic context transfer, and version history/checkpoints to preserve state. However, evidence is entirely first-party changelog/docs with no independent verification that context is preserved without loss across handoffs, and no concrete example of a multi-tool handoff working end-to-end. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of lossless handoff, a documented cross-agent handoff walkthrough, and confirmation that context/state survives complex multi-step tool transitions.
